notes.title: Clan Dungeon 2nd Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/577c9b0fae32745a39837055ad3ecbc58125db56.png[/img]

As the Black Dragons Clan rises in power, they extend their control deeper into the land. The Shaolin and Sacred Flower clans, originally thought to be impenetrable, have been compromised. As this threat extends beyond individual clans, a temporary alliance has been made, to make all clan dungeons available to any willing to take on the Black Dragons. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons for both the Shaolin and Sacred Flower, you can participate in to obtain materials to create a new set of powerful relics, in addition to the armor sets and clan skills already available.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.

[list]
[*]Level Requirement: 230+
[*]Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
[*]You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
[*]Each dungeon can be entered once per day, for a total of 4 entries. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
[*]Create New Equipment.
[/list]

[h2]New Clan Dungeon Entrances[/h2]
To ensure that every clan dungeon can be accessed by any clan, the dungeon entrances have been move to the Highlands of Bamboo Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/83533765cbf023e26d7503dd41733112066e752e.png[/img]

[b]Wu-Tang Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b82fcd0a1857e3ce28db3316ecbefc825c4e8f37.png[/img]

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[b]Heavenly Demon Dungeon[/b]
Enter Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter True Heavenly Demon Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/c6b9fcd59fabc8531b83966844a39461cc0b17bf.png[/img]

Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[b]Shaolin Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Shaolin Dungeon by clicking the Red Statue

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/0149fbc650d2586bb3a0a47d557f583f1e530f90.png[/img]

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

[b]Sacred Flower Dungeon[/b]
Enter the Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking the Blue Statue. Enter the True Sacred Flower Dungeon by clicking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7d95ecea76292a3bc47be5acdf5d426ff21e27a9.png[/img]

Defeat all deviant waves, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The final boss will have 2 forms.

[h2]Rewards[/h2]
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.) For a limited time, True difficulty dungeons will give 1 extra Clan Additional Reward Box for both Solo and Party Dungeons.

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

[*]Clan Dungeon Contribution Gold Reward Box
[/list]

notes.title: Update: Wu-Tang and Yanmo Dungeons
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/222cc7cdc47f2952d2c897c8414ee54ae82c3d65.png[/img]

The Black Dragons Clan has been spreading throughout the land and has ended up particularly close to home. With headquarters reaching into both the Wu-Tang and Heavenly Demon, it is up to you to investigate and eradicate the splinters from within your clan. It will be dangerous, however, with great risk, comes even greater rewards. In this update, we are introducing two new raid format dungeons, in both Wu-Tang and Mount Yanmo, in which you can obtain materials to create all-new armor sets and a brand new set of skills for all roles.

Access the dungeon solo or party with four players to defeat fearsome monsters and obtain top-tier equipment.
[list]
[*]Level Requirement: 230+
[*]Solo or four players parties can enter the dungeon.
[*]You can choose between Normal and Hard (True) dungeons.
[*]Up to 4 entries are allowed per day. (Solo: Normal/True, Party: Normal/True)
[*]Create New Equipment.
[/list]

[h3]Wu-Tang Dungeon[/h3]
White Clan players can access the Wu-Tang Dungeon in Wu-Tang Shan. Enter the True Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Red Flame. Enter the Wu-Tang Dungeon by clicking the Blue Flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/f9cc83fa7f5712b944bc444d9ac3bc704cba04b2.png[/img]

There are a total of 4 stages. Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[h3]Yanmo Dungeon[/h3]
Black Clan players can access the Yanmo Dungeon in Mount Yanmo. Enter True Yanmo Dungeon by clicking the Red Flame. Enter Yanmo Dungeon by clicking the Blue Flame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/b12c0081dd65092fd268cd36ee749abde99f939d.png[/img]

There are a total of 4 stages. Defeat all deviants, including one Sub-Boss and one Final Boss. The door leading into the Final Boss stage will not open until all deviants are defeated.

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
You can receive additional contribution rewards when you party up with 4 players. The type of rewards is differentiated between Normal and True difficulty. Rewards will be distributed according to who has dealt the most damage to the boss monster. (Same system as East & West Temple.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4bff7c6ce424e91e63e1468a73a8dd7219dd6541.png[/img]

The reward UI can be accessed by clicking the green gift box on the right-hand side of your screen.

A new set of powerful skills for each role, including a new lightfoot can now be obtained from the Ancient Secret Restorer, Keumbi Ho in Hefei.

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. [b]About Infinite Dungeon[/b]
[list]

notes.title: Update: Infinite Dungeon Renewal
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/64449698fb8bd97fd44a6559ab7caf99d713efa6.png[/img]

After the long wait, we are happy to release the renewal of the Infinite Dungeon! Get ready to wave goodbye to the Infinite Dungeon you once knew. With all-new challenging stages, reward features, and an updated point system, this update is sure to bring you great power and fortune. Did we mention there are new items, costumes, weapons, AND relics?

[b]About Infinite Dungeon[/b]
[list]
[*]The Infinite Dungeon is accessible to character level Revolving Chakra 1 (37) and above. You can access the dungeon interface by clicking the Infinite Dungeon Tab after pressing the F11 key.
[*]You will gain a certain amount of Challenge Points by clearing each stage while in the dungeon, and higher stages will payout more Challenge Points.
[*]Points earned can be used to buy various items from Infinite Master, Man Sangja.
[*]The number of daily entries to the Infinite Dungeon will be initialized at 00:00 server time, and the ranking will be calculated according to the stage and progress time.
[*]Additional point rewards will be given according to the ranking calculation at the last/first maintenance each month.
[/list]

[b]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  [/b]
[list]
[*]Stages and Difficulty Re-Adjustment  
[*]The number of stages is reduced from 50 Stages to 33 Stages, including 3 Reward Stages. The difficulty of stage 21 is similar to the existing stage 50, and starting at stage 23, it will be more difficult drastically.
[*]3 new bosses will spawn at stage 10, stage 21, and stage 32. The type of boss will appear randomly and have powerful skills.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/aec4a83abb47255e507606cc3b8451c2cfc0fe7e.png[/img]

[b]Infinite Entry and Infinite Stone Price Adjustment[/b]
[list]
[*]5 Entries (default) + 5 Entries (Infinite Stone) (10 Total) to 2 Entries (default) + 2 Entries (Infinite Stone) (4 Total).
[*]Infinite Stone (30 RC) to Infinite Stone (60 RC).
[/list]

[b]Be confident in your strength and rush in without the support of a party![/b]
Previously there were 2 modes to enter the Infinite Dungeon Solo and in a Party. However, the Infinite dungeon is now only open to Solo entries. Parties are not welcomed!


[b]Ranking Point Distribution[/b]
Stage Clear points and ranking reward points are adjusted depending on the newly designed number of stages and difficulty level. Each month, individuals on all servers Rank 1~50 will receive the following Challenge Point Rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/5a6e24523de33cbc3d2e491f598d5adee7be5769.png[/img]

[i]Infinite Dungeon Ranking will be reset each month during maintenance. Ranking Points will be distributed prior to reset periods.[/i]
[b]
Point Shop Items Changes[/b]
Due to the adjustment of point gain as well as existing points, the cost of point shop items has also been adjusted. Additionally, an assortment of new items has been added.

[i]Point Shop Page 1[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/fb1db5c0dd464b216e8b3e80561489785e99f986.png[/img]
[i]Point Shop Page 2[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/018d635708faaa7ab2812bcb74b4982577a91672.png[/img]

[b]Reward Stages[/b]
For reaching stages 11, 22, and 33, you will be granted a special treasure box in which you can receive valuable items. These stages will have no monsters and will not give out any points.

[i]Stage 11 Treasure Box[/i]
Contains one or more of the following items.

[i]Stage 33 Treasure Box[/i]
Contains one or more of the following items.

[b]Infinite New Equipment[/b]
A new weapon series called Infinite Dark Soul is added. The Infinite Dark Soul weapons can be traded using the latest materials. You can upgrade the Infinite Dark Soul weapons to tier 2, the Infinite Sandstorm Phoenix weapons, which have superior stats.

notes.title: Qingdao 1st Release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/8e5f4afd6136867578c1edf58f55507814b97a84.png[/img]

Qingdao is a village of night, the town of lust and decadence. The village is under the control of the Black Dragon Clan, so the White and Black clan can not easily unleash their momentum.

When dusk falls in the town, the market street becomes sleepless and chaotic due to merchants, thugs, thieves, and gamblers. Rumor has it that the money and treasure collected from the black market and casino are equivalent to Clan of Golden Coins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/12b00250ef8b34f7e8ffff0e5b3905c322982f66.png[/img]

The entrance of Qingdao gateway is located in Hefei near the Strolling Valley. There are several NPCs in front of the gate who can provide various information about Qingdao.

Combat is possible in Qingdao and PvP is encouraged. Low ranks should be aware of the invasions from other players.

[b]White Cloud and Black Cloud Basin[/b]
The town is divided into two villages across from a memorial tower called the Ghiryu Tower. Warriors on Black Cloud and White Cloud Basin villages must build up their strength to seize the opposite side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/4f70b2b384a300505960d1aa42c2a1750523c9e2.png[/img]

[b]Qingdao Deviants[/b]
Emperor Lei, the ruler of the Black Dragons Clan has gone missing. In his wake, the Black Dragon retainers, The Five Heroes From Darkness have free reign to rule over Qingdao. The Five Heroes from Darkness are composed of Magi, the Black Widows Blood, Kwakil, the Shadowless Sword, Hansung, the Flaming Steel Prince, Pyoje, the Hurrican Sword, and Chaewon, the Double-edge Fangs. The strength of deviant evil forces in Qingdao is no joke! Countless warriors came to challenge the deviants in the name of freedom, but none of them have survived to tell the tale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/7e25c4641d5000fa1e7c6abdcc11644bc8b0e169.png[/img]

[b]Ghiryu Tower[/b]
Ghiryu Tower is the symbol of true warlords. Each floor has vicious and fearsome deviants lie in wait. The gate into Ghiryu Tower will be open sometime in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/665fede115484a4b8d113b48358d779ec3a341ef.png[/img]

[b]New Road to Enlightenment and Heroic (Daily) Quests[/b]
Talk to Yang Wuqi in Hefei to lead you into your journey to liberating Qingdao from the clutches of the Black Dragons clan and their legion of followers through an assortment of new quests. The villagers need your help and are prepared to reward you handsomely for your efforts!

[b]Create New Items and Increase Your Strength[/b]
Gather material items from helping villagers in quests and slaying members of the Black Dragons Clan to create an assortment of new items that will help you recruit Comrades that will aid you in battle, or build Weapons and Armor to give you the strength to stand over your enemies!

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27673923/46175e37537a4620d4a4ebb870ac332f13380349.png[/img]

[h1]Swords of the Dragon Warlord - The Book of White Dragon Spirits[/h1]
For the past few decades, a great number of skilled warriors have been in search of 2 legendary artifacts called, [i]Nine Dragon Jade Circle[/i] and [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i], scouring the land, whenever a clue presents itself.

During their never-ending journey, many warriors from various clans have learned and improved their kung-fu skills exponentially by defeating evil deviants and members of the rival clans in their way.

The legend of the [i]Swords of The Dragon Warlords[/i] is proven by renowned archaeologists over numerous years showing evidence that this artifact is more than just a myth.

The legendary [i]Nine Dragon Jade Circle[/i] was an accessory, which belonged to the Thunder Emperor, a great legendary warrior. He carved his ultimate kung-fu techniques on the surface of a circle accessory and scattered it's 9 pieces before heading out to the final battle of the War of Nine Dragons.

On the other hand, the tale of the [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i] tells of how the swords were magically forged using 5 sacred elements, and the spirits of 5 Dragons sealed within. According to legend, those who acquire all 5 swords shall unlock the secret passage of the Treasure of the Dragon Warlord, which is has been said to be the key to achieve the status of [i]Overlord of the Mighty Dragons[/i].

The Thunder Emperor had the chance to gain the [i]Black Dragon Warlord Sword[/i], one of the 5 legendary swords, and has achieved Super Metamorphosis, leaving a bloodbath in his wake.

After countless years of searching, a secret room has been discovered in Potala Palace, during their most recent clan battle. What was so important in about the tiny room, that it had been sealed for decades? Even the elders and high councils of the palace had no idea of its existence. Within the dusty room lay nothing, but an old bookshelf containing the legendary [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i]. This was one of the greatest discoveries of the century, proving the story of the [i]Swords of the Dragon Warlords[/i] was more than just an ancient myth.

Without hesitation, the leaders of well-established clans rushed to Potala Palace in Tibet, in order to conduct an expedition to unlock and obtain the secrets of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i]. Countless souls perished during their investigation, but nothing could stop them from acquiring the precious book, as they paved the roads to Potala Palace with blood.

The strongest 6 clans were no exception but realized that the battle over the legendary artifacts must be halted before any further expeditions could be conducted. Ultimately, the leaders of the 6 clans had an official meeting and came to an agreement to forge 6 copies of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i], to be passed down to the successors of each clan head, putting an end to the surrounding chaos.

After the forgeries of the [i]Book of White Dragon Spirits[/i] were handed to the leader of each clan, leading scholars and archaeologists are gathered to decode the ancient text and reveal the path to become the [i]Overlord of the Mighty Dragons[/i].

The decoding process was a very tedious and complicated process, uncovering the meaning of only 3 sentences thus far:

[b]Crimson Fog[/b]
[i]"Everywhere is filled with blood, smoke, fog, and corpses..."[/i]

[b]Scattering Souls[/b]
[i]"Difficult to perform techniques by scattering one's vital energy."[/i]

[b]Silent Fortress[/b]
[i]"There is no safe zone due to the surrounding delicate formations."[/i]

[h1]Hainan Location[/h1]
Hainan Island is located on the southern edge of China.
You can move only if you have an item called Hainan Teleport Scroll, which will teleport you to a random spot on the island.
You can acquire the scroll from the Hainan Survivor, Masked Man in Hefei.
The only way to leave the island is to ride on a boat at the shoreline to Liaodong. However, please notice that once you leave, you will have to use another Hainan Teleport Scroll to return.

The Guardian Spirits have protected us against adversity since time immemorial. And now in our greatest need, they are beginning to awaken. With the introduction of our Guardian System Update, we are happy to bring you an in-game event in which you can participate and earn some great rewards.

[h1]Trace of Guardian[/h1]
Search through dungeons for signs of the guardians who seek you! For the duration of the event, gather as many Trace of Guardian as possible by defeating mobs over level 150 in the following dungeons.
[LIST]
[*]Purple Dungeon: The School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[*]Green Dungeon: Valley of Hell, Mansion of Silver Coins, Wild Tower, Beast Tower, Mansion of Gold Coins, School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[*]Red Dungeon: Death Valley, Valley of Hell, Mansion of Silver Coins, Wild Tower, Beast Tower, Mansion of Golden Coins, The School of Rising Sun, Icy Dungeon, Black Temple, and Potala Fortress.
[/LIST]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/12add5a5990a410eeef76c9fb85a2fcb0863fae9.png[/img]

Trade them into the Guardian Exorcist NPC Oh, Minyoung in exchange for some great stuff, including new Guardian Spirit related items!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/ae27ae35c3cc08a354b1a9e90250b58183c580ea.png[/img]

[I]Oh, Minyoung’s Mystical Creature Box[/I]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/2349222543e94fe82023bf87c2526c1fcf4ed291.png[/img]

[h1]Playtime Bonus[/h1]
Each day you log in, make sure to click your “Stamp Tracker” icon located below the mini-map in the game to receive your reward(s). The longer you stayed logged in, the more rewards you receive! [B]Storm vs. Storm Update[/B]
Storm vs. Storm (SvS) is a power struggle between Hero Bands that occur every week, where players attempt to capture Stone Pillars to gain rewards.

notes.title: Update: Costume Gallery
notes.notes:
In this update, you will be able to register Costumes into your Costume Gallery, which can be accessed via F11, where you can change, unequip, and add additional stats to all of your Costumes.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/1b64fb6b853df2e1c6ba5acd910a63780938977c.png[/img]

[h1][B]Costume Gallery Registration[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In order to register a Costume into your Costume Gallery, you will need to purchase slots using in-game gold.
[*]You can purchase a maximum of 6 Gallery slots using gold, then for slots 7 through 50, you will need to use Costume Slot Ticket, which can be purchased in our Marketplace.
[*]To Register a Costume, simply right click on the Costume you wish to register in your inventory.
[*]The icon for the selected deco will appear in the Costume Registration and Extraction section.
[*]Upon clicking the Register button, you will be asked to confirm registration of your Costume into the Costume Gallery.
[*]Keep in mind that once you register a Costume, it will be deleted from your inventory and will be permanently registered.
[*]Additionally, timed Costumes cannot be registered to your Costume Gallery.
[/LIST]
[h1][B]Cost of Costume Gallery Slots[/B][/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27673923/8524403cd1991e9df42db7daabad5a93511f348e.png[/img]

[h1][B]Potential Abilities and Extraction[/B][/h1]
[LIST]
[*]In the Costume Gallery system, you will be able to add Potential Abilities, or stats, to your Costume, by clicking on the Fabric icon in the Ability section.
[*]Ability slots are ranked 1 - 5 with the first slot being Rank 1, and the last slot being Rank 5.
[*]To unlock Ability slots, you will need to use Fabrics, which can be gained through Costume Extraction, by right clicking a Costume in your Inventory and clicking the Extract button in the Costume Registration and Extraction section of your Costume Gallery UI.
[*]Keep in mind that Clan, timed, or opposite gender Costumes cannot be entered for Extraction.
[/LIST]
